title: LEGION-186 test: both fixes verified on their real surfaces at head 63c7e484; every acceptance line 1–6 holds

implementerProof.how: Re-ran both of the implementer's commands on the same surfaces at head 63c7e484. (1) `bun test packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/index.test.ts -t "same-agent rule through the wired daemon"` → 1 pass, 10 expect() calls: boot resurrected WIDGETS-42 with --resume, /process/started from ses_FRESH_AGENT → 409 {"error":"Worker respawn must resume the same agent session"} with the architect claim and locator untouched, then ses_root_original → 200. Its 'fails on main' half reproduced independently: exported main 8fce288e via git archive into a throwaway /tmp dir (index.ts cmp-identical to main's, still `(tree, generation) => api.mintBootToken(tree, generation)`), copied the branch's index.test.ts over it → 0 pass, 1 fail, Expected 409 Received 200. Second witness: the planner's /tmp/legion-186-plan/root-same-agent-wiring.main.test.ts (the reviewer's repro) against this workspace → 409, claim ses_root_original, 1 pass. (2) The real-CLI shim run with OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql and a providers file named OMP_SESSION_STORAGE → exit 1 in 0.29 s, stderr naming the key and its file path, no dial line, child never spawned; its negative control (LEGION_TEST_PROVIDER_KEY, unset, under timeout 3 → dial lines, exit 124) reproduced. Unit lock re-run: worker-shim.test.ts 35 pass, -t runWorkerShim 3 pass (refuse case asserts CliError with key and path, 0 dials, 0 spawns).

proof.criterion: Acceptance 1 and 2: a resumed root whose /process/started arrives from a different session is refused 409 by the wired daemon with the architect claim untouched; the recorded session registers 200; index.ts narrows no mint's arity.
proof.surface: The full-daemon harness — startDaemon over the fake tmux runtime, the real index.ts ProcessManager deps block (mintBootToken/mintWorkerBootToken as `(...args) => api.X(...args)`, index.ts:565-573 read), the real /legion/v1/process/started route — plus a throwaway git-archive export of main 8fce288e under /tmp for the pre-fix half.

proof.negativeControl: The identical test file on main 8fce288e's wiring (throwaway export, index.ts byte-identical to main — `cmp` clean) → 0 pass, 1 fail at `expect(refused.status).toBe(409)`: Expected 409, Received 200 (the fresh agent silently accepted). proof.criterion: Acceptance 3: the worker shim refuses to start — exit 1, message naming the key and its file path, Oh My Pi never spawned — when a providers-Secret key is already a variable of its environment; a NAME_FILE-pointed key is skipped, not refused; a non-colliding key still passes to the dial.
proof.surface: The real CLI as a real process with a real environment: `bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts worker-shim --connect …` (this branch's build of the entry the pod runs) with OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql exported and a temp providers directory; plus the same entry from the throwaway main 8fce288e export for the pre-fix half.
proof.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/legion-186-shim.XXXXXX) && printf file > "$d/OMP_SESSION_STORAGE" && printf tok-1 > "$d/boot" && OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=sql bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts worker-shim --connect tcp://127.0.0.1:1 --boot-token-file "$d/boot" --provider-env-dir "$d" -- sh -c "touch $d/spawned"; echo exit=$?; test -e "$d/spawned" && echo SPAWNED || echo not-spawned
proof.observed: exit=1 after 0.29 s; stdout empty; stderr exactly one line: `legion worker-shim: --provider-env-dir key OMP_SESSION_STORAGE (/tmp/legion-186-shim.plUgvr/OMP_SESSION_STORAGE) is already a variable of this pod's environment; exporting it would silently override that value — rename or remove the providers-Secret key`; zero `daemon stream … unavailable` lines (no dial); not-spawned. A file named GH_TOKEN under `GH_TOKEN=` (empty) is refused the same way — an empty variable counts as set, as the pod's emptied GH_TOKEN requires. Regression lock: worker-shim.test.ts 35 pass, 139 expect() calls; -t runWorkerShim 3 pass — refuse (CliError naming OMP_SESSION_STORAGE and its path, dialer.connections 0, spawnEnvs 0), skip (DISPATCH_TOKEN with DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE set not exported, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exported, exit 0, one dial), export (non-colliding key reaches the fake spawn's env, exit 0, one dial).
proof.negativeControl: (a) The file renamed LEGION_TEST_PROVIDER_KEY (confirmed unset) under `timeout 3` → `[worker-shim] daemon stream 127.0.0.1:1 unavailable (Failed to connect); retrying in 200ms` … 400 … 800 … 1600 ms, exit=124, not-spawned: a non-colliding key passes resolution and dials. (b) A file named DISPATCH_TOKEN with both DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE=<path> and DISPATCH_TOKEN=already-set exported → dials, exit=124: the NAME_FILE pointer skip runs before the collision check, so the production pod (DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE, ENVOY_TOKEN_FILE set) is never refused. (c) The pre-fix CLI from the main 8fce288e export with the colliding OMP_SESSION_STORAGE key → dials, exit=124: main accepted the shadowing key silently.

acceptance.evidence: Full-daemon test green at head (409 then 200, claim untouched), red on a fresh export of main 8fce288e (Received: 200); planner's repro → 409 against the fixed workspace.

index.ts:571-572 read: `mintBootToken: (...args) => api.mintBootToken(...args)` and `mintWorkerBootToken: (...args) => api.mintWorkerBootToken(...args)`; no named-parameter wrapper on either mint; bunx tsc --noEmit exit 0; the Acceptance 1 test is the behavioural pin.

Real CLI: colliding OMP_SESSION_STORAGE → exit 1 naming key and path, no dial, no spawn; NAME_FILE-pointed DISPATCH_TOKEN skipped (dials); non-colliding key dials; empty GH_TOKEN counts as set. Unit: runWorkerShim refuse/skip/export 3 pass with fake connect and fake spawn, refuse case proving 0 dials and 0 spawns; readProviderEnvDir pointer-wins case added.

The three reviewer-listed sentences are byte-identical between main 8fce288e and head (docs/kubernetes.md 'When that row is missing' paragraph and the 'mints its boot token with the session id the previous generation registered … answers a different id with 409' sentence; the init-container --resume paragraph 'starts a fresh session with a new id that the daemon then refuses to register'; daemon AGENTS.md /process/started row 'a rootSessionId that differs is refused 409') and are now true by the Acceptance 1 test. New prose read against readProviderEnvDir/runWorkerShim: docs/kubernetes.md's shim export paragraph clause and providers-Secret paragraph (collision rule, example message matching the real stderr format, NAME_FILE skip), root AGENTS.md Commands line for worker-shim --connect ('refusing to start — exit 1 naming the key and its file, Oh My Pi never spawned'), daemon AGENTS.md worker-shim bullet ('exits 1 naming the key and its file, before any dial or spawn, and a key the pod reads through a NAME_FILE pointer is skipped as before') — each matches the observed behaviour. The docs' 'the pod is Failed and the daemon counts the launch failure' is the Kubernetes runtime's existing documented exit-1/restartPolicy Never path, reasoned from the probe row, not run (no cluster required by the spec).

The implementer's E2E line names the full-daemon harness (Acceptance 1) and the real-CLI shim run (Acceptance 3), each with command, observation, head SHA f966494d and a negative control; implement.json carries both as its proof array. This tester repeated both at 63c7e484 and wrote the E2E (tester) line into PR #1128's body in place (verified live body equals the edited file modulo GitHub's trailing newline).

`jj diff --from 'fork_point(main@origin | 63c7e484)' --to 63c7e484 --summary` (fork point 8fce288e) lists neither packages/contracts/src/legion-daemon-api.ts nor packages/pi-envoy/package.json; LEGION_DAEMON_API_VERSION = 5 and legion.daemonApiVersion 5 at head.
